title: Sun's Edge
description:
From KC Studios, the creator of KC Chronicles and Crimson, comes Sun's Edge, an Action RPG set in a handcrafted world, featuring souls-like combat and Zelda-like open maps to explore.

In the jungles and deserts of a decaying world, Machete chooses to spend his final days in the realm of Aztec deities and monsters. He must trail blaze deep into the Crimson corruption, fight tough bosses, solve unique puzzles, and find the lost Crystal Shards before his world is consumed… And his brother is lost forever.

• Fast paced combat where every battle matters. Face off against dangerous creatures using swords, bows, guns, and other improvised weapons. Mix different weapons and power ups to build your character.

• Cook meals, gather resources, upgrade armor, and prepare for the danger ahead.

• A Story Mode campaign that will take you through a unique, hand crafted world.

• Update your Bestiary journal as you encounter enemies and exotic creatures.

• Snoop around to find hidden lore drops, solve secret puzzles, and fight bosses to collect treasure, and find out the dark truth of Cipactlan.

• Zen Garden to retreat to when you need a break from adventuring and want to catch some fish and cook food to prepare for the next expedition.

• Gather food, wood, and obsidian as you explore; craft meals that make you stronger, upgrade your tools, and more.

• Mix and match items together for combined effects. Fire and Lightning plus Poison and Ice? Go ahead and try it. Each weapon type has a different play-style. 

• Play it simple if you choose, or customize your moves with the Skill Tree. Upgrade your stats and learn new attack moves to turn the fight in your favor.

• This is one for the fans of the Hack-and-Slash genre. Be prepared to cut down any obstacle that blocks the way. The end of the world is at stake!

"What would you do if the world was ending? Spend time with loved ones? Go on that trip you've always wanted? Or risk everything and try to stop it? Tomorrow is never guaranteed. Despite it all, we push on even when everything seems impossible."• You are a Ranger, on a mission to retrieve the Crystal Skull Shards that have fallen into the hands of evil. 

• Embark on an 'Aztec Odyssey' through many different lands in the Jungle Saga. Be ready to locate missing persons, deliver medicine to remote tribes, stop villages from being invaded, and more.

• Rich in Aztec and Mesoamerican mythology. Inspired by Aztec, Navajo, Incan, and other pre-Columbian nations.

• Every jungle and dungeon you explore holds many different threats. Watch your neck and be prepared for hidden traps, puzzles, and treasure lurking in the dark.

• Evil spirits have moved into the Mangrove and are attacking! Play the 1 hour free demo and explore the vast flooded forest, experiment with weapons and power ups, and defeat all the bosses!

• Recent reports suggest a crystal shard was spotted in the area, it may be related...
